name: Boots of the Battle Herald
body:
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 227
Aura moderate enchantment; CL 11th
Slot feet; Price 30,000 gp; Weight 2 lbs.
Description
These boots are made of fine white leather tooled with scenes of epic battles. Once per day as a move action, the wearer can affect himself with greater heroism for 11 minutes.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, greater heroism, remove fear; Cost 15,000 gp
